# Cyclecoop pricing

Price calculation with wrapper modules.
start.lib/pricing.rb:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Cyclecoop
  LOG = []

  module Metered
    def price(units)
      LOG << 'Metered>'
      out = super(units + 5)
      LOG << '<Metered'
      out
    end
  end

  module Traced
    def price(units)
      LOG << 'Traced>'
      out = super
      LOG << '<Traced'
      out
    end
  end

  module Audited
    def price(units)
      LOG << 'Audited>'
      out = super
      LOG << '<Audited'
      out
    end
  end

  class Trip
    def price(units)
      LOG << 'base'
      units * 7
    end
  end
end
start.main.rb:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'lib/pricing'

Cyclecoop::Trip.prepend Cyclecoop::Metered
Cyclecoop::Trip.include Cyclecoop::Traced
Cyclecoop::Trip.prepend Cyclecoop::Audited
puts Cyclecoop::Trip.new.price(9)
puts Cyclecoop::LOG.join(' ')

# feeder runner

Proc and lambda helpers.
start.lib/runner.rb:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Small helpers around procs and lambdas for feeder jobs.
module Runner
  def self.with_proc(values)
    values.each do |v|
      pr = proc { |x| return x * 2 if x > 24 }
      pr.call(v)
    end
    :finished
  end

  def self.with_lambda(values)
    values.each do |v|
      la = lambda { |x| return x * 2 if x > 24 }
      la.call(v)
    end
    :finished
  end

  def self.counter
    n = 19
    [-> { n += 1 }, -> { n }]
  end
end
start.main.rb:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'lib/runner'

p Runner.with_proc([1, 29, 2])
p Runner.with_lambda([1, 29, 2])
inc, get = Runner.counter
inc.call
inc.call
p get.call
